record_scope_reconstruction: Ordinary industrial cross-border access to Kaesong was cut via the western Gyeongui road corridor. The southern transit-control complex is a geographically identified access site; the factory estate, Panmunjom diplomatic site and Dorasan railway station are not substituted.

source_checks.finding: Contemporary Yonhap reports expulsion and industrial closure, with final departure time uncertain.
Republished DPRK statement specifically cuts west-coast roads near KIZ across demarcation line.
Tenth-anniversary ministry account calls complex shuttered; ordinary industry not reopened.
Official ministry describes Gyeongui Paju and Donghae Goseong transit offices, associated roads and distinct railway history.
